faq.question: What exactly is in this blend?
faq.answer: BPC-157 and TB-500 co-lyophilized in one vial at matched ratios: 5+5 mg (code BB10), 10+10 mg (BB20) and 15+15 mg (BB30) per vial, 10 vials per kit.

faq.question: Does each peptide have its own COA?
faq.answer: Yes — the blend ships with analytical documentation for each component batch used, so both peptides are identity-confirmed.

faq.question: Why buy a blend instead of two separate kits?
faq.answer: Because it removes one reconstitution and handling step per experiment. Buyers who need independent concentration control often prefer separate kits; the choice is a protocol decision.

faq.question: Can the ratio be customised?
faq.answer: Yes — custom ratios and custom vial counts are available as an OEM configuration; minimum order quantity and lead time are confirmed at quotation.
